runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220 working draft)

official_documentation_checked.finding: The standard headers list no WAV or RIFF audio parser.
FILE, fopen and fread provide generic bytes, not parsed WAV chunks, sample rate or PCM frames.

limit: Scoped to ISO C; platform and third-party audio packages are listed separately. No format-aware standard API exists to run on the control.
